mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.user_id userId, u.actual_name userName, c.file_md5 fileMd5, c.file_name fileName, c.file_url fileUrl, c.is_dir isDir, c.is_valid isValid, a.share_status shareStatus, a.share_batch_num shareBatchNum, a.share_type shareType, a.extraction_code extractionCode, c.file_size fileSize, c.file_path filePath, c.extend_name extendName, a.share_time shareTime, c.delete_time deleteTime, a.end_time endTime, c.delete_batch_num deleteBatchNum FROM t_wp_share a LEFT JOIN t_wp_share_file b ON b.share_batch_num = a.share_batch_num LEFT JOIN t_wp_user_file c ON c.id = b.file_id LEFT JOIN t_base_user u ON c.user_id = u.id WHERE a.is_valid =1 and u.is_valid =1 and a.share_batch_num = #{shareBatchNum} and b.share_file_path = #{shareFilePath}
